index.title: IntegratED - Sikánewalar manush der sikha mojbut koró
index.hero_heading: Sikánewalar manush der sikha mojbut koró
index.hero_subtext: ACS Athens-e surú hoiché The Home Project-er sathe sikha aar shanskriti adan-pradan diye setu toirir uddeshye.
index.launch_p1: IntegratED ACS Athens-e Greece-e surú hoiché, jaa notun teknoloji aar proven shikkhon pothder mishiye ek poripurno sikhar byabostha toiri koré. The Home Project-er sathe sahajogitay aar udaar shohaayotay, aami sharnarthider shikha misher bonyad gorchi.
index.launch_p2: Amaader AI-cholito adaptive sikhar platform prottyek sikanoyder jonno shikkha byoktigoto koré, aar amaader juwaa banano system elakar volunteer-der aar shomaan shoukh-er sikhanayder ek koré, sotti bhalobasha aar shanskriti adan-pradan baraay.
index.launch_p3: ACS Athens theke surú korey, aami shudhu bishoy porabi na — aami bishshaas toiri korchi, integration baraachi, aar ujjol bhobishhot-er dik diye darja khulchi.
index.commitment_text: IntegratED sharnarthi aar dukkhit manush-der jonno boli aar digital shikhar shorile shikkha-r shujog dey. Aami bishshaas kori je shikha shomortho boro howar aar setu toirir khatir.
index.no_articles: Notun update aar program-er khabar eithaay shigir aashibo.
index.login_prompt: Age theke member? Log in koró
index.students_collaborating: Chhatro hola ek shathe kaaj korhché
index.meta_description: IntegratED Athens-e ekta youth-theke-youth sikha programme: student volunteer aar sharnarthi jowan ekshathe pashapashi shikhe, chobi aar shobdo diye toiri app diye.
index.hero_title_1: Jowan manush shikar kaaje shahajo koré
index.hero_lead: IntegratED Athens-e ekta youth-theke-youth sikha programme. ACS Athens-er student volunteer-ra The Home Project-er shohajotai thaka sharnarthi jowan-der shathe dekha koré, aar je shudhu porá shuru korché shei manushder jonno toiri app diye pashapashi shikhe.
index.photo_1_alt: Duijon kishor pora koré aar ekshathe tablet babohar koré
index.photo_2_alt: Ekta meye ekta chhelhe-ke tar homework-e shahajo koré
index.photo_3_alt: Duijon kishor ekshathe ekta tablet-e dekhché
index.mission_statement: Amra bishshaas kori je ekshathe shikha bhasha, shanskriti aar jowan manush-der moddhe setu toiri koré.
index.mission_detail: Amader shathe kaaj kora onek jowan-er pora bondho hoye giyechilo, aar kichu jon ekdom prothom-bar pora shikhché. IntegratED tader ajoke nijer boyosher ekjon-er shathe shikhar pothé phirey ashte shahajo koré.
index.who_learners_tag: The Home Project-er shohajotai thaka sharnarthi jowan
index.who_learners_text: Onekei pora bondho hoyeche, aar kichu jon kono bhashay ekdom prothom-bar porhche. Ekhane tara chobi aar shobdo diye, nijer gotite shuru korte pare.
index.who_volunteers_text: Tara ekjon learner-er shathe dekha korte, ekshathe onushilon korte aar pothe ekta bondhu-sulov mukh hote shomoy dey.
index.who_teachers_text: Tara learner-der volunteer-der shathe milay, prottek session-er hishab rakhe aar worksheet bitoron koré.
index.session_lead: Duijon jowan, ekta siká, aar onek utshaho.
index.session_1_text: Ekjon volunteer aar tar learner tader session-er jonno dekha koré.
index.session_2_text: Tara ekshathe learner-er poré-ta siká khole: ekta quiz ba paanchta khelar ekta.
index.session_3_text: Speaker-e tap koro, shobdo-gulo bolo, aar kothin hole abar cheshta koro.
index.session_4_text: Dujonei session-ta log koré. Learner XP pay, level-e othe aar tar character-er notun shajo unlock koré.
index.demo_intro: Amader onek learner-i shudhu porá shuru koré, tai proti proshno-r shathe chobi aar speaker button thake. Ekhane amader English course theke tin-ta shotti proshno. Bhul uttor-e kono khoti nai: abar cheshta koro.
index.demo_idle: Jeita shotti mone koro, shei uttor-e tap koro.
index.demo_done_text: Tumi prothom-bar-e {total}-er modhye {correct} shothik korechho aar {xp} XP peyechho. Amader learner-der jonno proti siká ei rokom lage.
index.feature_audio_text: Speaker button proshno aar shobdo jor-e poré.
index.feature_languages_text: Menu aar shahajo learner-er nijer bhashay dekha jay, dan theke baam-e lekha lipi-o ache.
index.feature_abc_text: English course akkhor diye shuru hoy aar puro bakko porjonto uthe jay.
index.feature_retry_text: Bhul uttor lal hoy, aar learner abar bachchhe. Keu-ke ardhek theke shuru korte hoy na.
index.games_lead: Onek siká khela hishabe khela hoy, tai onushilon poriksha-r moto lage na. Proti shothik uttor khelake agiye neya.
index.game_rocket_text: Shohoj proshno-r uttor diye rocket-ke jalanó aar uré jao.
index.game_storm_text: Jhor-e uráiya nei aagey shothik shobdo bachao.
index.game_match_text: Jora khuje bor koré, jemon boro akkhor aar choto akkhor.
index.game_garden_text: Shothik uttor bagan-ke pani dey. Beej bono aar phool foté dekho.
index.game_potion_text: Ekta recipe bachho, shothik upadan nao aar ekta potion banao.
index.involve_lead: IntegratED chole jowan manush-der upor, ja ekjon arekjon-er jonno ashe. Tumi kivabe ota-r ongsho hote paro, shei bishoyé dekho.
index.involve_volunteer_text: ACS Athens-er student-ra iskul-er invite code diye naam likhe ekjon learner-er shathe milé jay.
index.involve_support_text: Daan programme-ke barhte aar aro jowan manush-er kachhe pouchate shahajo koré.
index.involve_learn_text: The Home Project-er jowan-ra teacher-er theke paowa invite code diye jog dey.
index.photo_session_alt: Duijon jowan ekshathe tablet-e kaaj korte hashché
index.design_lead: IntegratED-er protiti ongsho dhore nei learner hoyto ekhono porte parena, aar hoyto ingreji-o bolte parena.
index.door_student_text: Iskul-er invite code diye naam liká aar ekjon learner-er shathe milé jao.
index.door_school_text: Tomar chhatro-der jonno IntegratED niye ao. Roster, matching aar haajiri ektu-o agey theke-i ache.
index.door_support_text: Daan programme-ke aro jowan manush-er kachhe pouchate shahajo koré.
